Entering <void/>Void Invisibility, or going 12 seconds without having marked a combatant in PvE, marks a <link Non-Boss [#CombatantClassifications] /> target within <pve 45 /> <pvp [25] /> meters of you, prioritizing <link Minor [#CombatantClassifications] /> combatants close to your reticle. Target remains marked <pve indefinitely /> <pvp [15 seconds] /> until killed.

Defeating the marked target triggers a <void/>Void Smoke explosion at their death location and grants one stack of 'Successful Hunt' for 7  seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Successful Hunt instantly grants ?% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability energy upon being earned, and additionally provides ? Stability, ? Reload Speed, and ?% decreased Reload Animation Speed for its duration.

<void/>Void Smoke lasts for 7 seconds, deals damage over time, and can trigger melee-associated effects. Enemies within are Disoriented and <void/>Weakened, while allies that enter are granted <void/>Void Invisibility for 5 seconds (7 seconds with <void/>Echo of Persistence).
